versions.changelog:
**No feature or logic updates; metadata/description only.**

- Updated description to clarify autonomous use of OpenClaw's built-in Playwright browser
- Description now states no Chrome extension or DevTools needed, and operation is self-contained
- Emphasized that user is only contacted for login or irrecoverable errors
- Internal execution flow, rules, and functional guidance unchanged

Version 1.0.2 of igot-karmayogi

- No changes to files or code in this release.
- Retains all execution behavior, automation procedures, and documentation as in previous version.
- No user-facing or functional changes introduced.

Version 1.0.1 — Refined documentation and execution rules for reliability

- Clarified execution flow, DOM readiness requirements, and automation scope.
- Updated instructions to emphasize waiting for Angular component readiness before actions.
- Improved details on signal polling for video completion and quiz handling.
- Explicitly excluded any automated login attempts; user must always log in manually.
- Outlined new, stricter “never/always” rules and provided actionable waiting/interaction steps.
- Reduced verbosity and improved clarity for easier understanding by all users.

iGOT Karmayogi Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides fully autonomous automation of the iGOT Karmayogi portal using OpenClaw headless browser.
- Handles end-to-end course progression: enrolls, plays videos to completion, completes quizzes and assessments, and downloads certificates.
- Operates in a self-driving loop, requiring user input only for initial login and resolving rare errors.
- Notifies users only on major milestones (per event-based messaging rules) for a clutter-free experience.
- Includes robust error recovery and retry routine; pauses only if persistent issues occur.
- Requires user to manually log in to iGOT for security (reCAPTCHA/Keycloak bypass prevention).
